# Phase equilibrium of multiple condensables {#sec-ch04}

This chapter describes how kintera brings a mixture of gases and pure condensates to phase equilibrium when several
species can condense at once, including reactions that combine two vapours into one solid or release a gas as they
condense. It opens with the saturation conditions themselves: phase change written as a reaction of the nucleation
type, its reaction quotient, the logarithmic residual that measures the distance from the curve, and the two-sided
condition (equality with a cloud, inequality without) that decides which phases are present. Three solvers enforce
those conditions: the fixed-temperature, fixed-pressure adjustment of the mole basis, a Newton iteration on the
reaction extents with a constrained least-squares step; the fixed-energy, fixed-volume adjustment of the mass basis,
which eliminates the temperature through the energy constraint and recovers it by a caloric inversion after every
step; and the partition solver, a scalar bracket-and-Newton search in temperature for cards whose reactions are
disjoint vapour-cloud pairs, tried first under the default setting. The last section is the layer a host sees: the
batched drivers with their warm starts, the per-cell diagnostic and the failure count. The state vectors, the
caloric functions and the entropy the solvers rely on are those of @sec-ch03; the saturation curves are the data of
@sec-ch02; the constrained least-squares solver is the subject of @sec-ch10; the solver of the chemical equilibrium
of @sec-ch05 is a different method (equilibrium constants from the Gibbs energies of the species, not saturation
curves) and is not treated here. Every scheme ends with an executable check under
`src/kintera_report/ch04/checks/` whose output is committed next to it.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch04-conditions | `type: nucleation`, `rate-constant: {formula}` | no reactions: no phase change | exact | `test_reaction_equilibrium.py` |
| @sec-ch04-equilibrate-tp | `ThermoX.forward`, `max-iter`, `ftol` | 10, $10^{-6}$ | quadratic near the solution | `equilibrate_tp` of `test_thermo` |
| @sec-ch04-equilibrate-uv | `uv-solver: kkt` | `auto` | quadratic near the solution | `equilibrate_uv` of `test_thermo` |
| @sec-ch04-uv-partition | `uv-solver: partition` | tried first under `auto` | quadratic inside the bracket | `test_cuda_workspace.py` |
